WITH grouped AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(p.throws, 'Missing') AS throwing_hand,
           COUNT(*) AS winner_count
    FROM manager_award AS ma
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id
    GROUP BY COALESCE(p.throws, 'Missing')
),
shares AS (
    SELECT throwing_hand,
           winner_count,
           1.0 * winner_count / SUM(winner_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM grouped
)
SELECT SUM(winner_count) AS combined_tally,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares)) AS average_amount_above_average_share
FROM shares
WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares);
